title: Northstar Ventures — Investment Thesis
full_text: Northstar Ventures backs European climate and infrastructure founders from first product to scale. We lead Seed and Series A investments, typically writing first checks of EUR 500k-3m, and we stay hands-on through board seats and follow-on rounds.
claim_span: We lead Seed and Series A investments

title: GridFlow GmbH raises EUR 4,000,000 seed round
full_text: GridFlow GmbH today announced a EUR 4,000,000 seed round led by Northstar Ventures, with participation from Example Capital. The round will fund GridFlow's grid-flexibility platform for industrial energy customers.
claim_span: GridFlow GmbH today announced a EUR 4,000,000 seed round led by Northstar Ventures, with participation from Example Capital.
